name: vix_ease_macro_regime_filter
rationale: VIX easing only generates durable crypto upside when the broader macro regime is risk-supportive; the two together define a clean risk-on vol-regime shift. Thesis: arm long on vix_level cross_down within a supportive macro regime. Disconfirmer: require macro_regime > a fitted floor — if the VIX cross also works in an unsupportive macro composite then the vol-easing signal is not the driver and the strategy is really a macro-regime bet; conversely if it only works in already-bullish macro then the VIX cross is redundant. The conjunction isolates the regime-shift moment.
catalyst: VIX eases while macro regime turns supportive
